description: A production-grade AI chat platform supporting 5 LLMs (Gemini, GPT-4, Mistral, Cohere, DeepSeek) with RAG-powered document intelligence, real-time web search via Tavily, image understanding, live streaming responses via Socket.io, and Redis-backed secure authentication.
